streams.title: New playable characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada is the first character being brought over from another Warriors game. Other names in the planning sheet are long-term ideas, not confirmed additions.
streams.next: Continue Nobuyuki's outfit and movement checks, then confirm the extra character slot is safe to use.
streams.description: The character plan starts with Nobuyuki Sanada from Samurai Warriors 4. The long-term roster list gathers possible future additions from several games; it is a wishlist, not a promise that every name will be added.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Bringing Nobuyuki into the game with his Samurai Warriors 4 look and movement.
substreams.next: Finish checking the outfit's moving cloth and confirm the character works in-game.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki is the main character focus so far. The planning notes identify his Samurai Warriors 4 outfit and movement as the starting point. The public notes do not yet confirm the final in-game checks as complete.

plannedGroups.title: Berserk and the Band of the Hawk

streams.title: More costumes
streams.summary: The outfit plan includes looks from other Warriors games and beyond. Some are early ideas; Nobuyuki's character work remains the main focus.
streams.next: Continue the Sophitia braid checks, then choose the next outfit set to work on.
streams.description: This area covers bringing existing outfits into the game and making room for additional looks. The planning sheet is a wishlist, not a list of finished or announced outfits.

substreams.title: Sophitia outfits
substreams.summary: The Broken Destiny outfit has already been brought over; its moving braid still needs work.
substreams.next: Finish the braid movement checks, then review the other planned Soulcalibur looks.
substreams.description: The plan records Sophitia's Broken Destiny Player 1 outfit as already ported, with braid physics still in progress. Three Soulcalibur 2-inspired outfits are lower-priority wishlist items.

substreams.title: Samurai Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: The plan is to bring Samurai Warriors 4 looks to Samurai Warriors characters.
substreams.next: Confirm the first characters and outfits to include.
substreams.description: The spreadsheet lists outfit ports for Samurai 1, 2 and 3 characters as a high-priority direction. The plan needs a confirmed first set before it should be treated as active work.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors outfits
substreams.summary: Outfits from Dynasty Warriors 8 XL and 9 are on the longer-term list.
substreams.next: Pick a first character group and outfit set.
substreams.description: The planning sheet includes outfit ports for the Wei, Wu, Shu, Jin and Other 1 groups. These are wishlist entries, not confirmed finished outfits.

substreams.title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfits
substreams.summary: A Dynasty Warriors: Origins outfit set is listed as a future possibility.
substreams.next: Review whether this outfit set fits the project's scope.
substreams.description: This is an early planning-sheet entry and has not been confirmed as active work.

streams.title: Making room for characters & outfits
streams.summary: Before more fighters and outfits can be added, the game needs safe extra spaces and clear ways to find them.
streams.next: Recheck the character-slot test, then decide which new categories and outfit spaces to tackle first.
streams.description: This is the shared groundwork behind future characters, character-select categories and extra outfit slots. It is separate from creating a character or outfit: this work makes room for those additions.

substreams.title: More character spaces
substreams.summary: An early test found a possible way to add character spaces, but it needs another safety check before use.
substreams.next: Repeat the test with the corrected setup and check that the character and saved data remain intact.
substreams.description: A first test was left switched off while the extra character-space approach is checked. No new slot should be described as ready until the follow-up test succeeds.

substreams.title: New character categories
substreams.summary: The plan includes a Samurai Warriors 4 category for Nobuyuki and other possible new groups.
substreams.next: Confirm the first categories and how the new characters should be grouped.
substreams.description: The planning sheet proposes a Samurai 4 tab for Nobuyuki (tab 13), as well as possible new groups such as Other 3. The final list and order are not confirmed.

substreams.title: More outfit spaces
substreams.summary: Extra outfit spaces would make room for more character looks.
substreams.next: Confirm how many extra outfits can be supported and which characters need them first.
substreams.description: This groundwork is about making additional outfit choices possible and easy to find. The outfit wishlist is tracked separately under More costumes.

streams.title: A sharper picture
streams.summary: A picture-quality update is prepared for a careful in-game test, but it has not yet been checked in play.
streams.next: When testing resumes, install it in a separate test copy and check the opening stages.
streams.description: The prepared update aims to improve image clarity and visual quality. It is not yet confirmed working in-game, and testing is paused until it is safe to resume.

streams.title: Clearer, easier-to-use screens
streams.summary: Several screen layout and scaling fixes have been tested. A wider review is still needed.
streams.next: Review the screens in-game and note any remaining layout problems.
streams.description: The latest recorded update fixes a Gallery layout issue. Other screen and scaling work is waiting for a broader hands-on review.

streams.title: Bigger battles
streams.summary: The project is exploring how to show more fighters at once without slowing the game down.
streams.next: Finish reviewing the game's limits, then test changes carefully and measure performance.
streams.description: The work has mapped some of the game's limits and possible approaches. No larger battle size is confirmed as safe or complete yet.

streams.title: More battles to play
streams.summary: New and adapted battlefields are part of the project, but a first selection is still needed.
streams.next: Choose the first battlefields and the games they could come from.
streams.description: This covers both original battle ideas and battlefields adapted from other games. No confirmed shortlist or order has been published yet.

streams.title: New enemies
streams.summary: New enemy types are part of the wider idea, but the first choices are still to be made.
streams.next: List the enemy types to consider and what would make them different.
streams.description: This is an early project idea. The enemy types and how they should behave have not yet been chosen.

updates.title: Project areas and progress estimates added
updates.detail: The board now shows rough, manually maintained estimates. They are directional, not measured completion or promises.

updates.title: Gallery layout fix installed
updates.detail: An update addresses a Gallery screen layout problem. The wider screen-improvement work is waiting for review.

updates.title: Picture-quality update prepared
updates.detail: A visual update is ready for a future careful test; it has not yet been confirmed in-game.

updates.title: Extra character-space test paused
updates.detail: The first test was left switched off while a corrected follow-up check is planned.

updates.title: Bigger battles explored
updates.detail: The project is looking at ways to show more fighters without making the game run poorly.
